research.subject: Usopp
gaps: The supplied evidence supports Observation Haki but provides no evidence that Usopp possesses advanced Observation Haki or future sight by the end of Wano; that feature should not be included as a sourced ability.

The source material does not provide a complete manga-verified catalog of Usopp's named stars, Pop Greens, Dial combinations, traps, or minor weapons. The record therefore preserves a coherent subset rather than claiming exhaustive coverage.
No supplied page supports a 15-item purchasable upgrade tree, in-game currency, upgrade costs, cooldowns, unlock progression, or other game-system facts.

Numerical damage, health, range, projectile speed, targeting rules, ammunition capacity, and resource limits are not established by the supplied pages and would be gameplay adaptations rather than character evidence.
The supplied pages do not provide enough evidence to assign gameplay values to the strength, duration, area, or reliability of individual Pop Green effects.

The abilities page mixes manga, anime, non-canon, film, and post-Wano material, including later Elbaph references. Those sections were filtered out for the requested continuity, but the page's broad capture makes precise cutoff verification limited.

The official profile is concise and does not independently document every combat feat or named technique; many detailed claims rely on the supplied fan-maintained abilities summary rather than directly supplied manga pages.
No supplied evidence establishes Armament Haki, Supreme King Haki, a Devil Fruit, or any additional powered transformation for Usopp through the requested cutoff.
